key_insight: F3-AGI v4.0 combines gated learning, residual program synthesis, and active exploration to improve sample-efficient abstract reasoning on CPUs.
engineering_relevance: Its compute-saving learning and search mechanisms may inform resource-constrained engineering AI, but the abstract reports no solid-mechanics or constitutive-modeling validation.
method: Mistake-gated plasticity with Fisher-EMA preconditioning and virtual ATP gating.
Complexity-guided program synthesis with residual patches and smallest-pair early rejection.
512D random projections for Expected Free Energy exploration and dead-signature pruning.
evidence_signal: Offline CPU evaluation with zero LLM calls solved 57/400 ARC-AGI-1 tasks (14.25% pass@2) at 1.62 s/task mean latency, including 38/350 strictly uninspected hold-out tasks.
watch_item: The modest hold-out solve rate and synthetic or local auxiliary benchmarks limit claims of broad generalization.
paper_title: F3-AGI v4.0: Bioenergetically-Gated Active Inference, Metaplastic Preconditioning, and Residual Program Synthesis for Sample-Efficient Abstract Reasoning
